Title: MILK Makeup | Cooling Jelly Tint
Body (HTML):
A long-lasting blush and lip stain with a hydrating, bouncy jelly texture that glides on for a sheer, buildable burst of color that lasts all day.

Suggested Usage:

-On first use: Gently twist off the protective cap to remove and discard.

-Gently swipe or swirl the stick directly onto lip and cheeks.

-It dries fast, so work one cheek at a time and blend quickly with fingers, brush or sponge.

-Build to your desired payoff.

-Close cap back on tightly (listen for the click!) and store at room temperature, away from direct sunlight.

-To completely remove stain from skin, use an oil-based cleanser.

-Pro Tip: Sweep brush over stick, then onto cheeks for a softer, more diffused blush look. For more intense color, swipe on multiple layers. Want an even cooler refresh? Store your stick in the fridge.

Master dupe.
